verdict.rationale: Better Stack ships a built-in AI SRE agent. Users can chat with it online or tag @betterstack in Slack, and it investigates incidents using logs, metrics, traces, errors and web events. It also fetches logs or charts from natural-language requests, writes automated post-mortems and opens GitHub pull requests with suggested fixes, with automated actions gated on user approval. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the assistant (all evidence is marketing-page claims), independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Slack-native AI SRE agent that investigates incidents using your logs, metrics, traces, errors, and web events.
Chat online, inside Slack and in Claude Code using the MCP
Discussing an incident in Slack? Call the AI SRE simply by tagging @betterstack.
Get recent logs or chart visualizations by simply asking in natural language.
Get an automated post-mortem based on the incident timeline and Slack.
Got an exception? Get a pull request with a suggested fix waiting for you in GitHub.
The AI SRE suggests hypotheses but never takes any automated actions without your approval.
